reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-random message. The ticket is #88412, the Tier 2 escalation for the Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse tablet freezing on the bill-of-lading barcode scan at Door 6. Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2025-07-02, and Hollis is a member of that channel. In the reply I also pointed out #8841, a similar number for a different issue: the West yard Door 2 double-booking that Tobias flagged in #central-random yesterday.

The gbrain knowledge brain refused my search because its access token isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. I found the answer in channels Hollis belongs to instead. To fix the brain, an admin on the brain host needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`, or set the token up to act on behalf of named members.
